name: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the smallest model in DeepSeek's V4.1 architecture family, released in September 2026 with native visual understanding. It is a 552B-parameter mixture-of-experts model using a Causal Encoder-Decoder design that activates 8B parameters for input and 16B for output, with a KV cache about a quarter the size of the previous Flash generation. DeepSeek positions it for agentic coding and long-context work and reports it ahead of V4 Pro, replacing V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp on its API.
